title: AIO Media Asset stream configuration schema
description: Schema of an Asset's stream configuration for endpointType Microsoft.Media

autostart.description: Whether to start immediately. The default is true.

format.description: The image format for the snapshot. The default is jpeg.

snapshotsPerSecond.description: The number of snapshots per second to capture. Default is 1. If empty or 0, the source frame rate will be used. Example: 30 for a 30 snapshots per second; 0.0167 for approximately one snapshot per minute.

autostart.description: Whether to start immediately. The default is true.

format.description: The image format for the snapshot. Default is png.

snapshotsPerSecond.description: The number of snapshots per second to capture. Default is 1. If empty or 0, the source frame rate will be used. Example: 30 for a 30 snapshots per second; 0.0167 for approximately one snapshot per minute.

path.description: The path where snapshot will be written, by default set by the broker as /tmp/<namespace>/data/<asset>.

autostart.description: Whether to start immediately. The default is true.

format.description: The video clip format. The default is mkv.

duration.description: The duration of each clip segment, in seconds. The default is 60 seconds.

path.description: The path where clips will be written, by default set by the connector as /tmp/<namespace>/data/<asset>.

autostart.description: Whether to start immediately. The default is true.

mediaServerAddress.description: The media server address or IP. The default is media-server.media-server.svc.cluster.local

mediaServerPort.description: The media server port. The default is 8554.

mediaServerPath.description: The media server path, by default set by the connector as <namespace>/data/<asset>.

mediaServerUsernameRef.description: The media server username reference. The default is empty.

mediaServerPasswordRef.description: The media server password reference. The default is empty.

mediaServerPasswordRef.description: The media server password reference. The default is empty.

mediaServerCertificateRef.description: The media server certificate reference. The default is empty.
